content.title: Steelers dismiss 'Mean' Joe Greene death rumor
content.text: STEELERS'Mean' Joe Greene viral death hoax shut down by SteelersAndrew VasquezSteelers WireMarch 20, 2026, 3:25 p.m. ETKeep WatchingA viral rumor that falsely claimed that NFL legend "Mean" Joe Greene had passed away has since been rejected by the Pittsburgh Steelers.According to the staff at TMZ Sports, the Steelers dismissed the death hoax and told them that Greene was alive, allowing fans to breathe a sigh of relief.TMZ reached out to the Steelers following reports that Greene had died, and the team stated the report was "not accurate."Greene, one of the greatest defensive tackles in NFL history, recorded 77.5 unofficial sacks during his 13-year Hall of Fame career with the Steelers.
